description: Records the tools the business uses today and whether Serviche was given access to each, as Get started's Your tools step does: action pick (tools: [{ id } or { name }]), none, mark (tool, provided, note) or unmark (tool). Nothing leaves Sergio. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: record_tools_access
title: Record the business's other tools
